main_message: The programme operated in 14 districts during 2025 and supported 62 local partner organizations. Reported outputs include 18,430 training attendances, 4,820 household consultations, and 310 community planning sessions.
relationship_to_task: This fixed attachment summary is supplied to the Outline stage as user-provided evidence.

key_facts.fact: The programme operated in 14 districts during 2025 and supported 62 local partner organizations. Reported outputs include 18,430 training attendances, 4,820 household consultations, and 310 community planning sessions. Attendances are not unique beneficiaries. Women represented 58% of recorded training attendances. Two districts experienced delayed activities due to procurement and seasonal access constraints. The report describes these as implementation delays, not programme failure. A 2026 expansion to four additional districts is proposed but not yet funded. The report does not provide an independent impact evaluation or causal attribution.
